items.exampleEn: The company's workers elect two people to speak for them at board meetings.
items.exampleZh: 公司員工會選出兩位代表，在董事會上替他們發言。

items.exampleEn: An investigator from the insurance company looked at the damaged car.
items.exampleZh: 保險公司的調查員查看了那輛受損的車。

items.exampleEn: The school imposed a new rule: no phones during lunch.
items.exampleZh: 學校實施了一條新規定：午餐時不准用手機。

items.exampleEn: In the board game, each player is the commander of a small army.
items.exampleZh: 在那款桌遊裡，每位玩家都是一支小軍隊的指揮官。

items.exampleEn: The space museum displays an old missile beside the rockets that later carried people into space.
items.exampleZh: 太空博物館把一枚舊飛彈和後來載人上太空的火箭並排展示。

items.exampleEn: The commission will give its report next month.
items.exampleZh: 委員會下個月會發表報告。

items.exampleEn: Cats and dogs can become allies when they grow up together.
items.exampleZh: 貓狗一起長大時，也能成為盟友。

items.exampleEn: The number of refugees in the world has grown in recent years.
items.exampleZh: 近年來，全世界的難民人數持續增加。

items.sentenceEn: In history class, we learned how the first missiles were built.
items.sentenceZh: 歷史課上，我們學到最早的飛彈是怎麼造出來的。

items.audioEn: The students will elect a class leader on Friday, so please think about who you want.
items.audioZh: 同學們星期五要選班長，請想想你要選誰。
items.questionZh: 同學們星期五要做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The city formed a commission to study the traffic problem.
items.sentenceZh: 市政府成立了一個委員會來研究交通問題。

items.sentenceEn: Volunteers collected warm clothes for refugee families before winter.
items.sentenceZh: 志工們在冬天來臨前為難民家庭募集保暖衣物。

items.stemEn: The ____ asked each witness the same questions to find out what happened.
items.stemZh: 調查員問每位證人同樣的問題，想查出發生了什麼事。

items.stemEn: When the new manager tried to change everything, I found an ____ in my old boss.
items.stemZh: 新經理想把一切都改掉時，我發現老上司是我的盟友。

items.passageEn: Our town recently welcomed several refugee families, and the community worked together to help them. The town council formed a commission to find homes and plan classes for them, and the members elected a retired teacher as its leader. She proved to be a strong ally for the families, helping them find jobs and schools. Some people worried that the town might impose new fees to pay for the program, but a local investigator wrote a report showing that most of the money came from donations. A former navy commander even offered free sailing lessons to the children.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上最近迎來了幾個難民家庭，鎮民齊心協力幫助他們。鎮議會成立了一個委員會，幫他們找住處、規劃課程，委員們選出一位退休老師擔任主席。她成為這些家庭強而有力的支持者，幫他們找工作、找學校。有些人擔心鎮上可能會為了這項計畫加收新費用，不過一位在地調查員寫了一份報告，指出大部分的錢都來自捐款。一位前海軍指揮官甚至提供孩子們免費的帆船課。

questions.questionZh: 調查員的報告指出什麼？
options: 鎮上應該加收新的費用
這項計畫的花費實在太高

items.promptZh: 這位畫家受委託為市政府畫一幅大畫。
referenceEn: The painter got a commission to paint a large picture for the city government.
The city government gave the painter a commission for a large painting.
rubricZh: commission 在這裡指委託（例如 get a commission to…、give someone a commission 等）

items.promptZh: 這個村子每四年選一次村長。
referenceEn: This village elects a new head every four years.
Every four years, the people in this village elect a village head.
rubricZh: elect 指選出（例如 elect a village head 等）；寫被動 a village head is elected 也正確
固定發生的事用現在式；「村長」可寫，例如 village head、village leader 等
